sourceRefs.locator: Documents 35–36, pp. 278–279: opening and subscriptions to the 589 profession of faith, including Reccared, Queen Baddo and the confirming edict. The editor identifies the later copy.
Opening account of the assembly on 8 May, participation from Gaul, Baddo’s subscription and discussion of canons 2 (Creed) and 14 (restrictions on Jewish families).
ER 363, About the source: Homoian and Nicene Christians, Reccared’s conversion in 587, the 589 council and manuscript recensions.
Calendar notes. The proleptic Gregorian computational date is two days after the conventional Julian date in November 546 and May 589.

labels.de: Rekkared und Baddo beim Dritten Konzil von Toledo
labels.en: Reccared and Baddo at the Third Council of Toledo

note.de: Beim Konzil am 8. Mai traten das Königspaar und Bischöfe aus Hispanien und Gallien auf. Das Protokoll überliefert Baddos eigene Erklärung.
note.en: The royal couple and bishops from Hispania and Gaul took part in the council on 8 May. The record preserves Baddo’s own declaration.

original.conversionNote: Two days later in the proleptic Gregorian computation calendar.
